name: Kebab menu
looksLike: three vertical dots that open extra actions
stack of three dots at the end of a row
small dotted control beside an item
definition: A three-vertical-dot control that opens secondary actions for an item, usually in a dropdown menu.
whenToUse: Secondary actions on a table row

notConfusedWith.difference: Three horizontal lines usually open navigation; three vertical dots usually reveal item actions.

prompts.short: Add a kebab menu with a labeled three-dot trigger and keyboard-operable actions.
prompts.detailed: Add a three-vertical-dot button labeled for the item it affects. Open an accessible dropdown menu with 44px action targets, keyboard navigation, and Escape dismissal. Keep the dots decorative, expose expanded state, and return focus to the trigger when the menu closes.

reactTailwind: // Requires the Base UI variant of shadcn/ui dropdown-menu in the consuming project.
import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem } from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu";
export function MoreActions({ name, onRename }: { name: string; onRename: () => void }) {
<DropdownMenuTrigger aria-label={`More actions for ${name}`} className="grid min-h-11 min-w-11 place-items-center focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2">
vue: <!-- A disclosure of links uses native Tab navigation, not ARIA menu semantics. -->
a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; }
nav { display: grid; border: 1px solid currentColor; padding: 8px; }

a11yNotes: Give the icon-only trigger an item-specific accessible name
Use 44px targets, visible focus, and menu keyboard behavior
Hide the dots from screen readers and restore focus on dismissal
